column1: # PRIVATE_NAME hits the public-content leak guard accepts, one row per alias.
# Format: path<TAB>token<TAB>reason naming an issue (#N). token is the lowercased
# alphanumeric run the hit matched; any other private name in the same file fails.
# A path that itself spells a private name is given as sha256:<hex of the path>;
# that matches the one file only. Compute: printf %s <path> | shasum -a 256
# A row no hit uses fails as stale; delete it then.
# See #11535: these are the deprecated org-named aliases (the voice package name
# and the GITHUB_INSTALLATION_ID_<org> env var), kept with their deprecation
# warning by owner ruling; they and these rows are removed in the next major release.
